title: Find and claim lost money – Revenue NSW
summary: Use Revenue NSW's service to search for and claim unclaimed money held in accounts in NSW.
intro:
Revenue NSW holds unclaimed money from accounts held in NSW.

You can use Revenue NSW's unclaimed money service to:

It's free to search and claim. There's no time limit on making a claim.
who_can_apply: Individuals, companies, deceased persons, trusts, super funds, and charities who have unclaimed money held by Revenue NSW.
what_you_need: Evidence of your connection to the money
A letter from the entity that sent the unclaimed money to Revenue NSW, confirming you as the rightful owner
Your name or the owner's name

how_to_steps.text: Enter your/the owner’s name and the required security check code.
If your search is successful, any unclaimed money will be displayed.
Select the checkbox for any unclaimed money item/s and then select ‘Submit a claim’.

internal_links.text: Find unclaimed money with ASIC's MoneySmart

faqs.q: Is it free to search for and claim unclaimed money?
faqs.a: Yes, it is free to search and claim unclaimed money. There is no time limit on making a claim.

faqs.q: What do I need to search for unclaimed money?
faqs.a: To make a search, you only need your name, or the owner's name.

faqs.q: What do I need to make a claim for unclaimed money?
faqs.a: To make a claim, you need proof of identity, your bank account details, and evidence of your connection to the money.
